title: An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leveraging Query-Adaptive Intent Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.09491v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval

translated_title: 一种利用查询自适应意图检测的有效口语理解方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通过上下文学习实现了无需微调的口语理解（SLU），但直接的基于查询的检索可能会选择语义相似却与意图无关的示例。本文提出了基于原型提取的查询自适应意图检测方法（APEX），这是一个两阶段检索框架，首先使用意图级原型选择候选意图，然后在选定的意图空间内检索上下文示例。在SLURP数据集上的实验在完整转录和困惑度分层条件下使用精确匹配准确率（EMA）评估联合SLU性能，并对ASR生成的转录进行了额外的检索分析。与基于查询的检索相比，APEX在完整转录上分别使Qwen3 4B和Gemma-3-4B的EMA提高了4.34和3.97个百分点。在高困惑度输入下，APEX还分别带来了7.66和2.13个百分点的EMA提升。检索
tldr: 本文提出APEX两阶段检索框架，先通过意图级原型筛选候选意图、再在该意图空间内检索上下文示例，无需微调即可显著提升大语言模型在口语理解任务中的意图检测准确率，相比基于查询的检索最高可带来7.66个百分点的EMA提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes APEX, a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents via intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space, significantly improving fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding performance over query-based retrieval, with EMA gains of up to 7.66 percentage points.
